items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: I know you made all those records with her. Oh yes, I suppose I was.

ctx.x: He had the grand too then? Oh yes, he bought the grand. Yeah.

And when I went down in Alabama, I was trying to get my people all back home because we got caught in the flood down in Spreeport. And old man Miller sent me 20-month tickets. Who else was on the show with you? Did you ever travel with Ida Cox?

I know you made all those records with her. Oh yes, I suppose I was. She was here, you know. She has people over here on the water. She just died, I guess, a year or so ago. Is she dead? She died, yes.
